create_LTXSTGPipeline: create an LTXSTGPipeline instance from a pretrained LTX-Video model with STG guidance enabled
run_video_generation: run text-to-video generation with LTXSTGPipeline using prompts, negative prompts, and STG layer indices
encode_text_prompts: encode text prompts into T5 hidden state embeddings with attention masks for video generation
apply_spatio_temporal_guidance: apply spatio-temporal guidance by monkey-patching transformer blocks with forward_with_stg at specified layer indices
pack_and_unpack_latents: pack 5D latent tensors into 3D sequence format and unpack them back for transformer processing
